header.name: Machine Learning in Wireless Communication and Networks
header.description: This course will help students understand the applicability of machine learning and deep learning in wireless systems and networks. The course will start with an introduction to some of the fundamental concepts of machine learning as well as wireless communication. Then the students will be introduced with various important and interesting aspects of wireless networks, e.g., localization, spectrum sharing, mmWave communication, etc.. For each of these broad categories student will learn about case studies and applications where machine learning can be leveraged. Most of the course will be based on reading and discussing research papers. Assignments and project will be code implementation heavy.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Understand fundamental concepts of machine learning and wireless networks, and remember important concepts.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Understand recent research papers on machine learning in wireless and analyze the applicability of machine learning for those problems. Evaluate possible limitations of these works and create possible improvements.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Apply machine learning to wireless problems and create solutions to assignment and project problems.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Gain knowledge about the prospects of integration of machine learning in future generations of wireless networks.

lecture_topics: Review concepts of machine learning that will be useful for this course
discuss the utility of machine learning in wireless systems/networks (1st lecture)
Review concepts of wireless communication, systems, and networks that will be relevant for the course (2nd lecture)
Present fundamental ideas related to radio wave propagation
Then discuss a case study of radio wave propagation modelling using machine learning (3rd lecture)
Introduce the idea of RF localization and different types of RF localization
Then discuss the problem of received signal strength based localization and how it relates to propagation modelling (4th lecture)
Discuss a case study on using machine learning for received signal strength based localization (5th lecture)
Introduce the concepts of cognitive radio networks, spectrum sensing, signal detection, spectrum sharing
Discuss some examples of real world spectrum sharing paradigms (6th lecture)
Introduce the idea of automatic modulation classification and its utility
Then discuss a case study on machine learning based automatic modulation classification (7th lecture)
Discuss the problem statement for project and present some ideas to get the students started (8th lecture)
Discuss the potential of signal detection using machine learning in wireless networks
Then present a case study of deep learning based signal detection (9th lecture)
Introduce some fundamental aspects of mmwave communication and its differences with traditional frequency bands and communication systems
Then discuss the problem of initial access in mmWave communication (10th lecture)
Discuss a case study of beam training and initial access in mmWave communication via deep learning (11th lecture)
Discuss the cencepts of source coding and channel coding related to information theory (12th lecture)
Intoduce the cocept of AI-native communication systems
cover a case study on end-to-end deep learning based communication (13th lecture)
Back up class for project discussion/any lag/holiday (14th lecture)
